```{r}
library(pacman)
p_load(chromote, rvest, dplyr)


library_path <- .libPaths()[1]

lock_files <- list.files(
  library_path,
  pattern = "^00LOCK",
  full.names = TRUE
)

unlink(lock_files, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}

park_code <- "ARCH"

url <- paste0(
  "https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/",
  "Park%20Specific%20Reports/Recreation%20Visitors%20By%20Month%20",
  "(1979%20-%20Last%20Calendar%20Year)?Park=",
  park_code
)

#open chrome
chrome <- ChromoteSession$new()

#load url
chrome$go_to(url)
Sys.sleep(15) #pray

location <- chrome$Runtime$evaluate(
  "window.location.href",
  returnByValue = TRUE
)$result$value

title <- chrome$Runtime$evaluate(
  "document.title",
  returnByValue = TRUE
)$result$value
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
controls <- chrome$Runtime$evaluate(
  "Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('select, input, button')).map(x => ({
    tag: x.tagName,
    id: x.id,
    name: x.name,
    value: x.value,
    text: x.innerText
  }))",
  returnByValue = TRUE
)$result$value

```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
chrome$Runtime$evaluate(
  "(() => {
    const select = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('select'))
      .find(s => Array.from(s.options)
      .some(o => o.text.includes('Arches')));

    const option = Array.from(select.options)
      .find(o => o.text.includes('Arches'));

    select.value = option.value;
    select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true}));

    const button = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll('input[type=\"submit\"], button')
    ).find(x => /view report/i.test(x.value || x.innerText));

    if (button) button.click();

    return {
      selected: option.text,
      button_found: !!button
    };
  })()",
  returnByValue = TRUE
)$result$value

Sys.sleep(15)


body_text <- chrome$Runtime$evaluate(
  "document.documentElement.innerText || ''",
  returnByValue = TRUE
)$result$value

cat(substr(body_text, 1, 8344))

rest_of_data <- substr(
  body_text,
  8345,
  nchar(body_text) - 122
)

cat(rest_of_data)

body_lines <- strsplit(body_text, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

rest_lines <- body_lines[
  cumsum(nchar(body_lines) + 1) > 8344
]

rest_lines

```

```{r}
tokens <- unlist(strsplit(rest_of_data, "\\s+"))
tokens <- trimws(tokens)
tokens <- tokens[nzchar(tokens)]

tokens <- tokens[
  grepl("^[0-9,]+$", tokens) |
  grepl("^(19|20)[0-9]{2}$", tokens)
]

year_positions <- which(
  grepl("^(19|20)[0-9]{2}$", tokens)
)

months <- toupper(month.abb)

annual_rows <- lapply(seq_along(year_positions), function(i) {
  
  start <- year_positions[i]
  end <- if (i < length(year_positions)) {
    year_positions[i + 1] - 1
  } else {
    length(tokens)
  }
  
  block <- tokens[start:end]
  
  year <- block[1]
  total <- block[length(block)]
  monthly_values <- block[2:(length(block) - 1)]
  
  monthly <- rep(NA_character_, 12)
  monthly[seq_along(monthly_values)] <- monthly_values
  
  row <- c(
    Year = year,
    setNames(monthly, months),
    Textbox5 = total
  )
  
  as.data.frame(as.list(row), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})

visitation <- bind_rows(annual_rows)

names(visitation)[ncol(visitation)] <- "Year_vis"

write.csv(
  visitation,
  "../data/visitation/ARCH.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
```
